note: Two rows of RegVerID 2020 name the edition '2020' and '2020 revised'. Any errata entry in the register binds its variant's editions, and the binding refuses the conflict. Allowed twin: every other register of errata-delivered-and-column-additions-bind-or-refuse-per-register, whose RegVerIDs each carry one interpretation and bind.
fails_if: `scb_errata.edition_bindings` keeps the first interpretation of a native edition instead of refusing a second, different one, so the build completes
